title: factblock.graph/v1
description: What Graph.to_dict() returns: one statement (root), the statements linked to it, and the links, as known on as_of. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. nodes carry {id, label, type, when, resolution} and edges {id, from, to, label}, the fields a graph renderer takes as they are; the rest is FactBlock detail.

as_of.description: the instant the graph is read as of (ISO 8601)

root.description: the FactBlock id the graph is about

type.description: the block kind in capitals: CLAIM, PREDICTION, COMMITMENT, ENTITY, FACTOR, ...

resolution.description: the latest verdict known at as_of, in a renderer's words; null when none

role.description: how it links to the statement before it on the walk: cause, effect, support, supported, successor, predecessor, ...; 'this statement' for the root

verdict.description: the latest verdict's outcome as written

history.description: said, took effect, replaced, judged: one line

label.description: the edge type: CAUSES, SUPPORTS, SUPERSEDES, ...

said.description: the day the link was drawn

certificate.description: the why() certificate: as_of, valid_at, what was hidden, what rests on declared backfill
